ai: The poet wrote an ode to the autumn wind.
詩人寫了一首獻給秋風的頌詩。
We read Keats's famous ode in literature class.
我們在文學課上讀了濟慈那首有名的頌詩。
I forgot my phone charger at the hotel.
我把手機充電器忘在飯店了。
Do you have a charger that fits this laptop?
你有適用這台筆電的充電器嗎？
The battery charger takes about two hours to finish.
這個電池充電器大約要兩小時才充得滿。
The knight rode his trusty charger into the field.
騎士騎著他可靠的戰馬進入戰場。
In old paintings, the charger is often shown rearing up.
在古畫裡，戰馬常被畫成前蹄揚起的樣子。
He gets touchy when people mention his weight.
別人一提到他的體重，他就變得很敏感易怒。
My sister is a little touchy this morning, so be nice.
我姊姊今天早上有點易怒，你客氣一點。
Money is a touchy subject in many families.
金錢在許多家庭中都是敏感的話題。
Let's avoid touchy topics like politics at dinner.
晚餐時我們就避開政治這類敏感話題吧。

leonardo.zh: 李奧納多（義大利文藝復興時期的藝術家達文西的名字）
ai: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa.
李奧納多·達文西畫了蒙娜麗莎。
Leonardo was also interested in science and engineering.
李奧納多也對科學與工程很感興趣。
I put an artificial sweetener in my coffee instead of sugar.
我在咖啡裡加代糖而不是砂糖。
This soda uses a natural sweetener made from a plant.
這種汽水用的是從植物提煉的天然甜味劑。
Some people think the sweetener leaves a strange aftertaste.
有些人覺得這種代糖會留下奇怪的餘味。
Water is a colorless liquid.
水是無色的液體。
The gas is colorless and has no smell.
這種氣體無色無味。
He gave a colorless speech that nobody remembered.
他發表了一場平淡無趣的演說，沒人記得內容。
Her colorless life changed when she moved abroad.
她搬到國外後，原本平淡的生活有了改變。
We heard a nightingale singing in the garden at midnight.
我們在午夜聽到夜鶯在花園裡歌唱。
The nightingale is known for its beautiful song.
夜鶯以優美的歌聲聞名。
Her sojourn in Paris lasted only three months.
她在巴黎只待了三個月。
After a brief sojourn in the countryside, he returned to work.
在鄉間短暫停留之後，他回去工作了。
They decided to sojourn in a small village for the summer.
他們決定夏天在一個小村莊暫住。
The writer sojourned in Italy before finishing his book.
這位作家在完成著作之前曾旅居義大利。

aires.zh: 艾利斯（見 Buenos Aires 布宜諾斯艾利斯）
ai: Buenos Aires is the capital of Argentina.
布宜諾斯艾利斯是阿根廷的首都。
The flight to Buenos Aires takes more than twelve hours.
飛往布宜諾斯艾利斯要花十二個多小時。
I had fresh papaya for breakfast.
我早餐吃了新鮮的木瓜。
A ripe papaya is soft and sweet.
熟透的木瓜又軟又甜。
She blended papaya with milk to make a drink.
她把木瓜和牛奶打成飲料。
Many people were born into bondage in the past.
過去有許多人一出生就處於被奴役的狀態。
He felt that debt had kept him in bondage for years.
他覺得債務多年來一直束縛著他。
We spent our holiday on an Aegean island.
我們在一座愛琴海島嶼度假。
The Aegean coast of Turkey has many ancient ruins.
土耳其的愛琴海沿岸有許多古代遺跡。
The Aegean lies between Greece and Turkey.
愛琴海位於希臘與土耳其之間。
Ferries cross the Aegean every day in summer.
夏天每天都有渡輪往返愛琴海。
My godmother gave me a book on my birthday.
我的教母在我生日時送了我一本書。
She asked her friend to be the baby's godmother.
她請朋友當寶寶的教母。
The company has heretofore ignored this problem.
公司到目前為止都忽視這個問題。
Heretofore, the rules were not strictly enforced.
到此時為止，這些規定都沒有被嚴格執行。
The village welcomed an itinerant doctor once a month.
村子每個月都有一位巡迴醫生來訪。
He lived an itinerant life, moving from town to town for work.
他過著居無定所的生活，為了工作從一個鎮搬到另一個鎮。
The itinerant slept in barns during the harvest.
那位流動工人在收成期間睡在穀倉裡。
Itinerants often found short jobs on farms.
流動工人常在農場找到短期工作。
We walked home by starlight.
我們藉著星光走路回家。
The lake shimmered under the faint starlight.
湖面在微弱的星光下閃爍。
Please leave the boxes at the curbside for pickup.
請把箱子放在路邊等人來收。
The car stopped at the curbside in front of the cafe.
車子停在咖啡館前的路邊。
My grandfather worked as a docker for thirty years.
我祖父當了三十年的碼頭工人。
The dockers went on strike over their working hours.
碼頭工人為了工時問題罷工。
The building has an asymmetrical design.
這棟建築的設計是不對稱的。
Her face is slightly asymmetrical, like most people's.
她的臉有點不對稱，大多數人都是這樣。
The artist likes asymmetrical patterns.
這位藝術家喜歡不對稱的圖案。
Olives are often stored in brine.
橄欖常泡在鹽水裡保存。
The brine in the jar was cloudy.
罐子裡的鹽水是混濁的。
We brine the turkey overnight before roasting it.
我們在烤火雞前先用鹽水醃泡一整夜。
She brined the cucumbers to make pickles.
她把小黃瓜泡在鹽水裡做醃菜。
He went to the basketball tryout after school.
他放學後去參加籃球隊的選拔。
The tryouts for the school play start on Monday.
學校話劇的甄選從星期一開始。
He laughed inappropriately during the sad speech.
在那場令人哀傷的演說中，他不合時宜地笑了出來。
The children were dressed inappropriately for the cold weather.
孩子們穿得不適合這種寒冷的天氣。

maintained.zh: 維持；保持（maintain 的過去式、過去分詞）
ai: She maintained a steady pace throughout the race.
她整場比賽都保持穩定的速度。
The two countries maintained good relations for years.
兩國多年來一直維持良好的關係。

maintained.zh: 保養；維修（maintain 的過去式、過去分詞）
ai: The old bridge is well maintained by the city.
這座老橋由市政府妥善維護。
He maintained his car carefully, so it still runs well.
他細心保養他的車，所以車子還很好開。

maintained.zh: 堅稱（maintain 的過去式、過去分詞）
ai: The man maintained that he was innocent.
那名男子堅稱自己是無辜的。
She maintained she had never seen the letter.
她堅稱自己從沒看過那封信。
The worker shaped the table leg on a lathe.
工人用車床做出桌腳的形狀。
Our school workshop has a new metal lathe.
我們學校的工坊有一台新的金屬車床。
The film explores the duality of good and evil.
這部電影探討善與惡的二元性。
There is a duality in his character: he is both shy and bold.
他的性格有雙重性：既害羞又大膽。

hitting.zh: 打；擊中（hit 的現在分詞）
ai: He is hitting the ball harder than before.
他現在打球比以前更用力。
The rain kept hitting the window all night.
雨整晚不停地打在窗戶上。
The truck kept hitting the curb as it turned the corner.
卡車轉彎時一直撞到路緣。
I heard a bird hitting the glass door again and again.
我聽到有隻鳥一次又一次撞上玻璃門。
The king arrived with a large retinue.
國王帶著一大群隨從抵達。
The singer's retinue included a driver and two assistants.
這位歌手的隨行人員包括一位司機和兩位助理。
The first robin is a harbinger of spring.
第一隻知更鳥是春天來臨的預兆。
Some people see the new law as a harbinger of bigger changes.
有些人把這項新法律視為更大變革的先兆。
Dark clouds harbinger a coming storm.
烏雲預示暴風雨即將來臨。
The early snow harbingered a long, hard winter.
這場提早降下的雪預示了漫長而嚴酷的冬天。

vagaries.zh: 難以預料的變化；反覆無常
ai: Farmers must deal with the vagaries of the weather.
農民必須應付天氣難以預料的變化。
He was tired of the vagaries of the stock market.
他厭倦了股市的起伏不定。
Her grandfather was diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease.
她的祖父被診斷出患有阿茲海默症。
Scientists are searching for new treatments for Alzheimer's.
科學家正在尋找阿茲海默症的新療法。
The school has prescriptive rules about uniforms.
學校對制服有硬性規定。
Dictionaries should describe language, not be too prescriptive about it.
辭典應該描述語言的實際用法，而不是過度規範。
We like to patronize the small bakery near our house.
我們喜歡光顧住家附近的小麵包店。
Locals patronize this market every weekend.
當地人每個週末都會來這個市場消費。

patronize.zh: 以高人一等的態度對待
ai: Please don't patronize me; I understand the problem.
請不要用那種高高在上的態度對我，我懂這個問題。
The manager patronized the new staff and they felt insulted.
經理對新進員工擺出高人一等的態度，讓他們覺得受到侮辱。
His friends goaded him into jumping off the dock.
朋友們慫恿他從碼頭跳下去。
She was goaded by the criticism to work even harder.
那些批評激得她更加努力。
The farmer used a goad to move the cattle.
農夫用趕牛棒驅趕牛群。
Fear of failure was a goad that kept him studying.
害怕失敗是促使他不斷讀書的動力。
We adopted a friendly mutt from the shelter.
我們從收容所領養了一隻友善的米克斯。
The mutt followed me all the way home.
那隻雜種狗一路跟著我回家。
The two plans differ starkly in cost.
這兩個計畫的成本截然不同。
The empty room looked starkly white in the morning light.
空蕩蕩的房間在晨光中顯得一片慘白。
In a nutshell, we need more time and more money.
簡單說，我們需要更多時間和更多經費。
Here is the whole story in a nutshell.
整件事的重點就是這樣。
The squirrel dropped a broken nutshell on the grass.
松鼠把一片破掉的堅果殼丟在草地上。
Children made tiny boats out of a nutshell.
孩子們用堅果殼做了小小的船。
The doctor smiled reassuringly and told her not to worry.
醫生安心地微笑，叫她不用擔心。
He patted the dog reassuringly during the storm.
暴風雨期間，他安撫地拍了拍那隻狗。
My father goes to the barbershop every month.
我父親每個月都去理髮店。
There was a long line at the barbershop on Saturday.
星期六理髮店裡大排長龍。
Our new neighbor is an affable man who greets everyone.
我們的新鄰居是個和藹的人，會向每個人打招呼。
The teacher was affable and easy to talk to.
那位老師平易近人，很好聊。
Swimmers should beware of the strong undercurrent here.
游泳的人要小心這裡強勁的暗流。
The river looked calm, but there was a dangerous undercurrent.
河面看似平靜，底下卻有危險的暗流。

undercurrent.zh: 潛在的情緒；暗地裡的傾向
ai: There was an undercurrent of tension in the meeting.
會議中暗藏著緊張的氣氛。
I sensed an undercurrent of sadness in her words.
我從她的話裡感覺到一股淡淡的哀傷。
His grandfather was a collier in a small mining town.
他的祖父是個小礦鎮的煤礦工人。
The colliers went underground before sunrise.
煤礦工人在日出前就下礦坑了。
The project was doomed from the start.
這個計畫從一開始就註定失敗。
Everyone knew the old shop was doomed to close.
大家都知道那家老店註定要關門。

roadshow.zh: 巡迴演出；巡迴宣傳活動
ai: The band is going on a roadshow across the country.
這個樂團要展開全國巡迴演出。
The company held a roadshow to meet investors in several cities.
公司舉辦路演，在幾個城市與投資人見面。
This jacket is made of soft brown corduroy.
這件外套是用柔軟的棕色燈芯絨做的。
Corduroy keeps you warm in the winter.
燈芯絨在冬天很保暖。
He wore corduroys and a wool sweater to school.
他穿燈芯絨褲和毛衣去上學。
My corduroys are worn out at the knees.
我的燈芯絨褲膝蓋都磨損了。
She looked at the strange map with puzzlement.
她一臉困惑地看著那張奇怪的地圖。
To my puzzlement, the door was already open.
令我不解的是，門已經開著了。
He felt a growing uneasiness as night fell.
夜幕降臨，他越來越不安。
She tried to hide her uneasiness before the interview.
面試前她試著掩飾自己的不安。
The painting was purportedly made in the 1600s.
據稱這幅畫是十七世紀完成的。
The man purportedly lost his keys on the train.
據說那名男子的鑰匙是在火車上弄丟的。

unwieldy.zh: 笨重難用的；難以處理的
ai: The box was too large and unwieldy to carry alone.
這個箱子太大又笨重，一個人搬不動。
The company has an unwieldy system that slows everyone down.
公司的系統龐雜難用，拖慢了每個人。
She went to the doctor for a urinary infection.
她因為泌尿道感染去看醫生。
The urinary system removes waste from the body.
泌尿系統負責排出體內的廢物。
Workers must wear a respirator when they spray paint.
工人噴漆時必須戴防護面罩。
The firefighter put on a respirator before entering the building.
消防員進入大樓前戴上了呼吸防護面罩。
The patient was placed on a respirator in the hospital.
病人在醫院裡被接上了呼吸器。
The hospital bought new respirators for the ward.
醫院為病房添購了新的呼吸器。

stigmatize.zh: 污名化；貼上恥辱的標籤
ai: We should not stigmatize people who ask for help.
我們不應該汙名化尋求協助的人。
The media often stigmatizes certain neighborhoods.
媒體常常把某些社區貼上負面標籤。
After years of the same job, he felt jaded.
做了多年相同的工作後，他覺得很厭倦。
The jaded critic yawned through the whole show.
那位厭世的評論家整場表演都在打哈欠。
The test results were a vindication of her theory.
測試結果證明了她的理論是對的。
He felt vindication when the truth finally came out.
真相終於揭曉時，他覺得自己的清白得到了證明。
The reporters gave him a harsh inquisition about the accident.
記者們就那起事故對他嚴厲盤問。
After the test, I faced an inquisition from my parents.
考完試後，我遭到父母一連串的盤問。
The Inquisition was a church court in medieval Europe.
宗教裁判所是中世紀歐洲教會設立的法庭。
The book describes how the Inquisition punished people.
這本書描述宗教裁判所如何懲處人民。
The child blew on a dandelion and made a wish.
小孩對著蒲公英吹氣並許了願。
Yellow dandelions covered the lawn in spring.
春天時，黃色的蒲公英開滿了草坪。
Kiev is the capital of Ukraine.
基輔是烏克蘭的首都。
The Dnieper River flows through Kiev.
聶伯河流經基輔。
Christchurch is the largest city on New Zealand's South Island.
基督城是紐西蘭南島最大的城市。
We flew to Christchurch before driving through the mountains.
我們先飛到基督城，再開車穿越山區。
We need to reposition the camera to get a better view.
我們得重新調整相機的位置才能拍得更好。
The company plans to reposition its brand for younger buyers.
公司打算為年輕客群重新定位品牌。

cain.zh: 該隱（聖經中殺害弟弟亞伯的人）
ai: In the Bible, Cain was the first son of Adam and Eve.
在聖經裡，該隱是亞當與夏娃的長子。
The story of Cain and Abel is well known.
該隱與亞伯的故事廣為人知。
The fans looked at the singer with adoration.
歌迷們滿懷愛慕地望著那位歌手。
Her adoration for her grandmother never faded.
她對祖母的敬愛從未減退。
The villagers paid taxes to the local overlord.
村民向當地的領主繳稅。
In the story, the evil overlord ruled the whole land.
故事中，邪惡的霸主統治整片土地。
Exporting countries benefit when the price of goods rises.
出口國在商品價格上漲時會受益。
The exporting company ships tea to many countries.
這家出口公司把茶葉運往許多國家。

contending.zh: 競爭；爭奪（contend 的現在分詞）
ai: Three teams are contending for the title this year.
今年有三支隊伍在爭奪冠軍。
She is contending with a heavy workload right now.
她現在正在應付繁重的工作量。
The contending parties could not reach an agreement.
互相競爭的各方無法達成協議。
The judge listened to both contending sides.
法官聽取了相爭的雙方說法。
She reads astrology to decide which day is lucky.
她看占星來決定哪天是幸運日。
Many scientists say astrology has no scientific basis.
許多科學家說占星術沒有科學根據。

orlando.zh: 奧蘭多（美國佛羅里達州城市）
ai: Orlando is a city in Florida known for its theme parks.
奧蘭多是佛羅里達州的城市，以主題樂園聞名。
We took a flight to Orlando for the holidays.
我們搭飛機去奧蘭多過節。
Louisiana is a state in the southern United States.
路易斯安那是美國南部的一個州。
New Orleans is the largest city in Louisiana.
紐奧良是路易斯安那州最大的城市。
Hundreds of worshipers gathered at the temple.
數百名信徒聚集在寺廟裡。
The church was quiet except for one lone worshiper.
教堂裡很安靜，只有一位獨自禱告的人。
The three countries signed a tripartite agreement.
三個國家簽署了三方協議。
The report has a tripartite structure: problem, cause, and solution.
這份報告分為三部分：問題、原因和解決辦法。

uncharted.zh: 未知的；未標在地圖上的
ai: The ship sailed into uncharted waters.
船駛入了未標示於海圖上的海域。
Starting a business was uncharted territory for her.
創業對她來說是全新未知的領域。
A flock of starlings flew over the field.
一群歐椋鳥飛過田野。
The starling can copy the sounds of other birds.
歐椋鳥能模仿其他鳥類的叫聲。
She is a principled person who always tells the truth.
她是個有原則的人，總是說實話。
He took a principled stand against cheating.
他以堅守原則的立場反對作弊。
The hotelier greeted each guest at the door.
旅館老闆在門口迎接每一位客人。
A local hotelier opened a second hotel by the beach.
一位當地旅館業者在海邊開了第二家旅館。
The painting shows the crucifixion of Jesus.
這幅畫描繪的是耶穌被釘上十字架。
Crucifixion was a common punishment in the ancient Roman Empire.
釘十字架是古羅馬帝國常見的刑罰。
She got a manicure before the wedding.
她在婚禮前去做了美甲。
A manicure usually takes about forty minutes.
修指甲通常要花四十分鐘左右。
She likes to manicure her nails at home on Sundays.
她喜歡週日在家修指甲。
The salon will manicure your hands and nails carefully.
美容院會仔細為你修護雙手和指甲。
She is studying biochemistry at university.
她在大學主修生物化學。
Biochemistry explains how our bodies break down food.
生物化學解釋了我們的身體如何分解食物。
Put a little lubricant on the squeaky hinge.
在那個嘎吱作響的鉸鏈上抹一點潤滑油。
The engine needs a good lubricant to run smoothly.
引擎需要好的潤滑油才能順暢運轉。
The lawyer adduced new evidence to support her case.
律師提出新證據來支持她的主張。
He adduced several examples to prove his point.
他舉出幾個例子來證明自己的論點。
Canola oil is common in home cooking.
芥花油在家庭料理中很常見。
Fields of yellow canola stretched to the horizon.
